decisions_made.sr_gender: FEMININE. ya zametila, mne vazhno. Actions stay impersonal.

decisions_made.checklists: Variant A: inline message with toggle buttons per item. Auto-pin. Stored in workspace.checklists[].
decisions_made.voice: Groq Whisper API. OGG -> transcription -> intent router pipeline. Sprint 3.
decisions_made.morning_brief: Daily digest replacing old greeting. Always sends. If no tasks propose to fill the day. Time = profile.morning_time.
decisions_made.reminder_v2: Options: on task day / 3 days before / 1 week before. Time = profile.morning_time auto.
decisions_made.symbiosis_learning: Max 1 guiding question per session (Ahimsa). Saves to profile.deep_profile. SR synthesizes every 10 dialogues.
decisions_made.settings_menu: Removed: Smenity gorod + Projti anketu zanovo. Added placeholders for Reminders/Roadmaps/Checklists.
